text:
maria: FYI we found a medium CVE in our Debian base image during the nightly scan. I want to coordinate a full base-image rebuild + image rotation for staging and prod, plus RBAC/audit changes to tighten who can push images. Window target: next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thoughts?
jon: can we get a short rollback plan? last time a broken lib caused runtime failures.
alex: +1 for rollback plan. Also need to confirm KMS key usage for image signing and who has decrypt/verify perms.
sara: agree. suggest steps: 1) rebuild base in CI, 2) run vuln scan + tests, 3) stage deploy, 4) promote. keep image tags immutable (sha).
maria: here's a quick checklist I drafted:
```
- Rebuild base image from pinned sources (debian:stable-slim + pinned apt packages)
- Run squeaky CI: unit, e2e, smoke on stage pool
- Vulnerability scan (trivy, grype) and sigstore attestation
- Sign image with KMS-backed key (sigstore + key in customer KMS for private?)
- Update deployment manifests to sha tags and rollout strategy (maxUnavailable=1)
- RBAC: restrict image-push to `release-bot` and `image-ops` group
- Enable audit logging for image-pull/push in registry and k8s apiserver
- Rollback plan: redeploy previous sha, disable new image in registry and revert traffic
```
kevin: for KMS: we should rotate the signing key in staging first and ensure verify-only keys are in prod. ops-bot can help apply keypolicy changes.
ops-bot: queued key-rotation job for staging KMS key id `redwood-stage-2026-rot1` at 2026-06-12T02:10:00Z. Will report status in thread.
jon: RBAC change question: do we change helm release service account perms or create a dedicated `image-pusher` SA with narrow scope?
alex: prefer dedicated SA + OPA policy to enforce image tag immutability and only allow signed images. Example Rego rule snippet:
```
package k8s.admission

allow {
  input.request.kind.kind == "Pod"
  some i
  container := input.request.object.spec.containers[i]
  startswith(container.image, "registry.redwood.com/")
  signed(container.image)
}
```
maria: good. Also we need to enable k8s audit logs for the window to capture any unexpected gets/list/secrets reads tied to the rollout. @sara can you add the audit-level change and retention note?
sara: will set `--audit-policy-file` to include `RequestResponse` for pods, secrets, deployments and bump retention to 90d for the next 7 days around the rollout. I'll post the policy diff in #eng-sre.
kevin: vuln triage: CVE-2026-1456 affects openssl in our base. upstream patch applied in rebuilt image; ensure compat test for TLS handshake with legacy clients.
maria: assign owners: build: @jon, signing & KMS: @kevin, RBAC & OPA: @alex, audit + deploy window: @sara. Can we confirm owners here?
jon: ack, I'll own rebuild + rollback playbook.
kevin: ack for signing. will coordinate with ops-bot for key ops.
alex: ack, I'll write the OPA rule and update admission controller.
sara: ack, I'll schedule audit changes and coordinate with Eng-SRE on logs ingestion.
sec-bot: vulnerability CVE-2026-1456 assigned to kevin. Severity: medium. Remediation ETA: 48h.
ops-bot: staging key-rotation finished: SUCCESS. Signed test image `sha256:abcd1234` verified.
maria: thanks. Two quick clarifications: 1) will image rotation require a config change in Redwood Dedicated pools (reserved capacity)? 2) any customers on private who need notice?
jon: Dedicated uses pinned tags in pool config; need to update pool image tags and do a controlled drain to avoid eviction. estimate 30m per pool.
kevin: for private customers we need to send a change notice if we rotate their base image on their infra; already flagged to AE team.
maria: ok final ask: everyone, please add any missing checklist items before EOD Fri. I'll create the PR with the rebuild workflow and link back here. :thumbsup:
alex: adding one more: update image-scanning webhook to block unsigned images from being pushed to prod registry.
sara: will add auditing test case to CI to ensure audit entries appear for push/pull.
jon: created rollback runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/rebuild-rollback-2026 (private).
maria: perfect. I'll post final schedule once PRs land. Thanks all :rocket:
